claims.note: Source evaluates seven saliency methods on a ViT breast MRI classifier and states rankings depend on the perturbation strategy. But the masking-strategy comparison (Table 1) is shown for deletion AUCC only and only for the class-specific methods (the two attention-only methods are absent); insertion was evaluated under attention masking only.
